name: Alison the Witch
original_name: アリソン・ザ・ウィッチ
source:
A witch who looks like a child on the inside and out. She is a tomboy but a crybaby. During a witch hunt, Tsunuga and Carol rescue her from capture and torture, but... [spoiler]it is already too late as her mind already breaks at that point, and Carol delivers a coup de grâce to end her suffering.[/spoiler]

Her signature weapon is a pair of shotels.

[Edited from the [url=http://clockup.net/maggotbaits/character2.html]official website[/url] and in-game content.]

[spoiler]Even though she was beheaded and supposedly dead, she mysteriously reappears at the end of Chapter 3. She becomes a part of Tsunuga's group.[/spoiler]
